user.title: Set up PV Management
user.description: Basic setup only. After installation, go to Settings → Devices → PV Energy Management Spot for more features: Battery control, EPEX Spot, Energy benchmark, PV strings and more.

data_description.name: Name for this PV system
data_description.pv_production_entity: Ever-increasing energy counter (kWh) of the PV system. Only have a power sensor (W)? Create a Riemann integral helper first (W → kWh).
data_description.grid_export_entity: Ever-increasing energy counter (kWh) for grid export. Required for earnings calculation.
data_description.grid_import_entity: Ever-increasing energy counter (kWh) for grid import.
data_description.consumption_entity: Ever-increasing energy counter (kWh) for total household consumption.
data_description.battery_soc_entity: Sensor for battery state of charge in % (for recommendation)
data_description.pv_power_entity: Sensor for current PV power in W (for recommendation)
data_description.pv_forecast_entity: Sensor for daily PV forecast in kWh (for recommendation)
data_description.electricity_price_unit: Choose whether electricity price is in Euro or Cent per kWh
data_description.electricity_price: Used when no sensor is configured or sensor is unavailable
data_description.electricity_price_entity: When configured, this value is used. On failure: fallback to above value
data_description.feed_in_tariff_unit: Choose whether feed-in tariff is in Euro or Cent per kWh
data_description.feed_in_tariff: Used when no sensor is configured or sensor is unavailable
data_description.feed_in_tariff_entity: When configured, this value is used. On failure: fallback to above value
data_description.installation_cost: Total cost of PV system including installation
data_description.savings_offset: WARNING: Only use if no kWh offsets entered! Already amortised amount in Euro
data_description.energy_offset_self_consumption: WARNING: Only use if no Euro offset entered! Self consumption before tracking
data_description.energy_offset_export: WARNING: Only use if no Euro offset entered! Feed-in before tracking
data_description.amortisation_helper: Optional but recommended! Create an input_number helper (Settings → Devices → Helpers → Number, Min: 0, Max: 999999). The helper backs up total savings independently — so data survives updates or reinstalls. Without helper everything works, but savings reset to 0 after reinstall.
data_description.restore_from_helper: On next restart, restore savings from the helper value. Useful if you reinstall the integration but the helper still has the old value.

abort.already_configured: This PV system has already been configured

init.title: PV Management Settings
init.description: All features are here. Tip: Enable Battery, EPEX Spot, Benchmark and PV Strings for the full experience!

sensors.title: Energy Sensors
sensors.description: Configure energy sensors for PV, grid, and battery.

data_description.pv_production_entity: Total PV production in kWh (rising counter)
data_description.battery_soc_entity: Current battery state of charge in percent
data_description.pv_power_entity: Current PV power in Watt (for recommendation)
data_description.pv_forecast_entity: Daily PV forecast in kWh (for recommendation)

prices.title: Electricity Prices & Amortization
prices.description: Configure electricity price, feed-in tariff, and installation cost.

data_description.electricity_price: Used when no sensor is configured
data_description.electricity_price_entity: Optional: Sensor for dynamic electricity price (e.g. EPEX)
data_description.feed_in_tariff: Used when no sensor is configured
data_description.feed_in_tariff_entity: Optional: Sensor for dynamic feed-in tariff
data_description.fixed_price_compare: Fixed price for comparison (e.g. provider offer). Shows savings vs spot tariff.
data_description.installation_cost: Total cost of PV system in Euro
data_description.yearly_cost: Yearly costs like insurance, maintenance etc. Deducted from amortization calculation.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect with EPEX Spot and Solcast for better recommendations.

data_description.epex_price_entity: Current EPEX Spot electricity price sensor
data_description.epex_quantile_entity: EPEX Quantile (0=cheapest, 1=most expensive price of the day)
data_description.solcast_forecast_entity: Solcast PV forecast for today in kWh

helper.title: Amortization Helper
helper.description: The helper stores total savings (EUR) independently of the integration.

data_description.amortisation_helper: input_number entity for persistent savings storage
data_description.restore_from_helper: Restore savings value from the helper on next restart

battery.title: Battery Control
battery.description: Auto-Charge (grid charging at cheap prices) and Discharge Control (save battery for expensive hours).

data_description.battery_target_soc: Charge battery up to this level AND hold at this level during cheap prices
data_description.auto_charge_winter_only: Only charge from October to March (PV is sufficient in summer)
data_description.auto_charge_pv_threshold: Below this PV forecast, charging is recommended
data_description.auto_charge_price_quantile: 0=cheapest, 1=most expensive. At 0.2 only charge in cheapest 20%
data_description.auto_charge_min_price_diff: Min. difference cheap/expensive in ct/kWh (charging losses!)
data_description.auto_charge_min_soc: Only start grid charging when battery is BELOW this value
data_description.discharge_winter_only: Only active from October to March
data_description.discharge_price_quantile: 0=cheapest, 1=most expensive. At 0.7 only discharge in most expensive 30%
data_description.discharge_allow_soc: Battery can discharge down to this level when electricity is expensive

pv_strings.title: PV Strings
pv_strings.description: Configure up to 4 PV strings for comparison. Only strings with name AND sensor will be shown.

data_description.pv_string_1_kwp: Installed nameplate capacity in kWp (optional, for specific yield + performance ratio)

forecast.title: Load Forecast
forecast.description: Learns your hourly load pattern (24×7 matrix) from house consumption and provides forecasts for 1 h / 6 h / rest of today / tomorrow / 24 h. Ideal combined with EPEX price + Solcast. Fallbacks: <2 weeks → 7-day average, <3 days → persistence.

data_description.forecast_enabled: Creates 5 forecast sensors — pair with EPEX price and Solcast for charging logic
data_description.forecast_weeks: More weeks = more stable profile. 4 weeks = sweet spot
data_description.forecast_modal_drop: Drop the highest + lowest value per cell (recommended)
data_description.forecast_hp_entity: HP total energy sensor (kWh) — subtracted from base load
data_description.forecast_ev_entity: Wallbox total energy sensor (kWh) — subtracted from base load

advanced.title: Advanced Settings
advanced.description: Thresholds for the recommendation traffic light and PV system configuration.

data_description.pv_peak_power: Peak power of your PV system in Watt (e.g. 10000 for 10kWp)
data_description.winter_base_load: Base load in winter (e.g. heat pump) - subtracted from available PV
data_description.battery_soc_high: Above this value, battery is considered full (for traffic light)
data_description.battery_soc_low: Below this value, battery is considered empty (for traffic light)
data_description.price_low_threshold: Below this price, electricity is considered cheap (for traffic light)
data_description.price_high_threshold: Above this price, electricity is considered expensive (for traffic light)

benchmark.title: Energy Benchmark
benchmark.description: Compare your consumption with the average for your country.

data_description.benchmark_heatpump: When active, heat pump consumption is benchmarked separately
data_description.benchmark_heatpump_entity: Total kWh counter of heat pump (optional, for fair comparison)
data_description.benchmark_heatpump_date: When the heat pump was commissioned. If set, the total sensor value is divided by operating days for accurate yearly values.

reset.title: Reset Data
reset.description: Select which tracking data to reset. This cannot be undone!
